correctness.rationale: The affine-invariant definition S(K)=L_K^(2dim K)=det Cov(K)/vol(K)^2 gives exact S(P×Q)=S(P)S(Q). For P⊕1Q, beta-fiber integration yields vol=p!q!/d! vol(P)vol(Q) and covariance block scale ((p+1)(p+2))/((d+1)(d+2)) (and analogous q), giving stated exact C_pq. Its split-ratio equals h(p+1)/h(d-p), h(x)=(1+1/x)(1+2/x)^x; h(1)=h(2)=6 and h strictly increases on [2,∞), so C_pq maximized on boundary p=1. C_1,d-1=6 d^(d+1)/((d+1)(d+2)^d)<1 for d>=3, equality only d=2. Exact rational independent checks: C_1,2=243/250, C_2,2=576/625, C_1,5=6561/7168. Cross and cube covariance/volume recursions and Hanner product/l1 induction prove both extremal bounds and equality classes (2D parallelogram affine coincidence). The supplied exact-rational checker was inspected; its d≤40/d≤9 samples cannot replace the all-d proof.

originality.rationale: Kipp 2025 full paper derives structural necessary conditions for local maximizers and a few zonotope classes, not an all-Hanner exact isotropic interval or this l1 recursion and equality classification. Kim 2014 concerns minimal Mahler volume product near Hanner bodies rather than covariance determinants; Rademacher 2016 similarly treats necessary conditions for global maximizers. Resultary search returned the assessed record and other polytope invariants but no dominator. Novelty remains best-of-knowledge with risk of an unindexed elementary Hanner covariance formula.

value.rationale: Hanner polytopes are a canonical recursively closed family in symmetric convex geometry; exact isotropic extremals within that family settle a sharp natural slice of an important open shape-optimization problem. The l1 transformation law supplies structural mathematical understanding for any Hanner construction, and rigidity of endpoint classes is more than evaluating cube and cross-polytope constants.
